name: Retrieves a customer.
context:
GET /admin/directory/v1/customers/{customerKey}
Retrieves a customer.
Required: customerKey (path) — Id of the customer to be retrieved
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Patches a customer.
context:
PATCH /admin/directory/v1/customers/{customerKey}
Patches a customer.
Required: customerKey (path) — Id of the customer to be updated; body (body)
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.

name: Updates a customer.
context:
PUT /admin/directory/v1/customers/{customerKey}
Updates a customer.
Required: customerKey (path) — Id of the customer to be updated; body (body)
Optional: fields (query) — Field mask limiting which response fields are returned, e.g. sheets.properties.
